author: Noema II
title: Dual-expert (scalar gate + post-norm) + grad-clip=1.0 — BiGRU=160, k=7 — seed=42
abstract: Base best config with global-norm gradient clipping (1.0) added to the optimizer to stabilize training and recover PRS while retaining ncRNA/Modif gains.
